faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SGNP Borivali recruitment?

faq.answer: Applications for the SGNP Borivali recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the direct link provided. Make sure to fill out the form accurately.

faq.answer: SGNP Borivali has released a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Deputy Director.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SGNP Borivali recruitment.

faq.answer: Sanjay Gandhi National Park Borivali is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400066.
